messages:
kai (Customer): Hey team — after our IdP rotated certs last night some of our users see 403 on SSO. Happens intermittently across regions. SP logs show 'RecipientMismatch' and 'AssertionConsumerServiceURL does not match configured ACS'. We did NOT change ACS in our app. Can someone triage? I can paste metadata and logs.

lena (Support): Sorry you're hitting this, we'll take a look. Can you paste the IdP metadata URL or the raw XML and the SP entityID you have configured? Any sample SAMLResponse (base64) or logs around a failed login would help.

kai (Customer): Metadata URL: https://idp.example-corp.com/metadata.xml. SP entityID: https://app.customer.example.com/saml. Fast repro: click 'Login with SSO' -> redirect to IdP -> back -> 403. Sample SP log: 
```
2026-03-16T22:01:12Z sso: inbound SAMLResponse from idp.example-corp.com
error: RecipientMismatch: expected https://app.customer.example.com/saml/acs but got https://app.customer.example.com/saml
```
(Notice ACS in config has trailing slash while logs show without.)

thomas (SRE): Interesting — trailing slash differences are a common culprit. Two quick checks: 
1) curl -I the metadata URL (to see redirects) 
2) dump the metadata-watcher last poll status: `kubectl logs deploy/metadata-watcher -n infra | grep last_poll`
If the IdP served a 302 or gzip/encoding that the watcher didn't follow, it might have persisted an older cached copy with different EntityDescriptor or key order.

kai (Customer): Ran a few things: 
```
$ curl -I https://idp.example-corp.com/metadata.xml
HTTP/1.1 302 Found\nLocation: https://cdn-idp.example-corp.com/metadata.xml
```
Then:
```
$ curl -I -L https://idp.example-corp.com/metadata.xml
HTTP/2 200
content-encoding: br
content-type: application/samlmetadata+xml
```
Logs from our side: 
```
metadata-watcher: last_poll_status=200 last_etag="v42" signature_check=failed thumbprint_mismatch
metadata-watcher: ignoring refreshed metadata because KeyDescriptor order changed
```
So the watcher logged thumbprint_mismatch and then kept the old metadata.

lena (Support): That matches what I suspected. A few angles: 
- The IdP's metadata CDN is doing redirects + brotli; our watcher follows redirects but sometimes downstream signature verification fails if the certificate ordering/key use attributes change.
- The SP ACS canonicalization differs (trailing slash). Our validation checks the AssertionConsumerService `Location` value exactly.
Workarounds: 
1) Upload the metadata XML to the tenant in the Console (Support -> Security -> IdP metadata upload) so we bypass the remote poller for a short window.
2) Temporarily add both ACS variants to allowedRecipients (with and without trailing slash).
3) Restart the metadata-watcher to force a fresh fetch and signature re-check: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/metadata-watcher -n infra`.

kai (Customer): I uploaded the metadata to the console as a quick test. Also added both ACS variants to allowedRecipients. Restarted watcher as suggested. Commands we used: 
```
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/metadata-watcher
kubectl -n infra logs deploy/metadata-watcher --since=5m | tail -n 40
```
Initial logs now show: 
```
deploy-bot: started rollout for deploy/metadata-watcher (revision 32 -> 33)
metadata-watcher: fetched metadata from https://cdn-idp.example-corp.com/metadata.xml
metadata-watcher: signature_check=passed selected_signing_key=SHA256:AA:BB:CC
metadata-watcher: applied new metadata for entityID https://idp.example-corp.com
```
After this, one of our QA users reported success.

thomas (SRE): Great. Two permanent fixes to suggest: 
- Normalize ACS in SP config to the canonical form returned by IdP (or use a canonicalization step in the SP to accept both). Trailing slash/absence must be treated consistently. 
- If the IdP publishes multiple KeyDescriptor entries, ensure our metadata-watcher tolerates key-order changes by matching by thumbprint, not position — filing a runtime bug for that.

marie (Product): Noted for the metadata-watcher UX: we'll add an admin console hint when uploaded metadata differs from last-polled (thumbprint or ACS differences) and show a one-click apply + validation.

lena (Support): For your immediate post-mortem, can you confirm whether any customers still see failures? Also, can you share the chunk of metadata that changed (we only need the KeyDescriptor sequence and the AssertionConsumerService entries)? If you prefer, we can sanitize cert bodies.

kai (Customer): All green now for the 3 testers. I'll run a small canary across a subset of users for 2 hours and report back. Attaching sanitized diffs in a follow-up DM. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

lena (Support): Cool — ping here when the canary completes. If anything flares, we can roll back to the console-uploaded metadata while we coordinate with IdP. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: rollout complete for deploy/metadata-watcher (revision 33) — 3/3 pods ready

kai (Customer): Canary finished, no regressions. Root cause summary I'll include in the ticket: IdP metadata change (key ordering + brotli CDN + redirect) caused metadata-watcher signature verification to fail and fallback to stale metadata; stale metadata referenced ACS with trailing slash while actual Assertion used non-trailing-slash URL; result: RecipientMismatch -> 403. Fix: Console upload + watcher restart, normalize ACS in config.

lena (Support): Perfect summary, I'll update the support ticket with remediation steps and recommended follow-ups (metadata-watcher tolerance improvement, console UX hint). Thanks everyone. :heart:
